overview_description.description:
It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that rounds up your everyday purchases and invests the spare change in bitcoin, to a dynamic app bringing a better way to manage all things money, with better money. 

Our mission is to empower people to better finance their future by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We are rebuilding finance from the group up by building the first crypto-native bank that leverages Bitcoin and stablecoins to revolutionize consumer banking.

product.name: Bitstack App
product.description: A mobile application for buying, selling, storing, sending, receiving, and automatically saving in Bitcoin, with transactions available from €1.

product.name: Automatic Round-Ups
product.description: A savings feature that rounds eligible purchases up to the next euro and converts the difference into Bitcoin automatically.

product.name: Smart Recurring (Achat Récurrent Intelligent)
product.description: An automated Bitcoin investment plan that schedules recurring purchases and adjusts their amounts according to Bitcoin’s market price relative to its 60-day moving average.

product.name: Bitstack Card
product.description: A payment card for everyday spending that is designed to support Bitcoin round-ups and Bitcoin rewards on purchases; availability is being rolled out.
